doc.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Ellington band plays Greensboro
summary: The Ellington band visited the club and played a dance; he describes how different it sounded.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Did I read somewhere that Ellington came through?
Yeah, Ellington came down there. He came down to the club, and brought all the musicians. We met them, talked to them. Russell Procope...
The band played an engagement there?
What was it like hearing the Ellington band?

Oh, it was great. It was much different than the other bands. Ellington actually had a different type of band. But I had heard about all the guys and read about them, so I just wanted to see them—like Taft Jordan and Cootie Williams, then he brought Jimmy Hamilton in... He had a great band. Russell Procope. It was a great band.
